portfolio_mandate: Generate positive risk-adjusted SEK returns (target Win Rate >= 65%, Profit Factor >= 2.0) by matching strategy archetype to each stock's 5-day Kaufman Efficiency Ratio (ER), enforcing RVOL >= 1.05, sizing positions by fixed 450 SEK 1R risk, ratcheting stops to +0.15R at +0.85R profit, and trading bidirectionally (MINI L Longs in uptrends above EMA50, MINI S Shorts in downtrends below EMA50).

key_learned_rules: During multi-week post-earnings corrections (Close < EMA50), block long breakout chasing and either trade MINI S breakdowns below OR_Low + VWAP or wait for a bounded PD_Low liquidity sweep + EMA4/VWAP reclaim.
Require RVOL >= 1.05 and Opening-Range-adjusted stop sizing (eff_vol = max(atr14, 0.45 * OR_Range)).
AMZN frequently exhibits a low 5-day Efficiency Ratio (ER < 0.28) where chasing high breakouts above OR_High fails (-1,142 SEK in naive breakout mode).
Switching AMZN to OR_Low / VWAP Sweep-and-Reclaim with a +0.85R breakeven ratchet turned AMZN into a 100% win-rate (+1,669.31 SEK) performer.
Never buy GOOGL inside the Opening Range (Close < OR_High) or against a falling 50-bar EMA.
When GOOGL breaks OR_Low + VWAP below EMA50 with Bearish OR polarity, MINI S shorts capture high-conviction trend continuation; when above EMA50, require OR_High clearance + +0.85R profit lock.
Avoid mid-range entries on META; demand either an OR_Low/OR_High liquidity sweep reclaim in low-ER regimes or an EMA50-aligned ORB breakout with RVOL >= 1.05.
On high-beta TSLA, require a green Opening Range bar (OR_Close > OR_Open), Daily Higher-Low (OR_Low > PD_Low), and Close > VWAP & EMA4.
Use Opening-Range-adjusted volatility (eff_vol = max(atr14, 0.45 * OR_Range)) so tight early-session ATR14 values do not choke out winners.
AMD has wide intraday ATR swings; always enforce deterministic 450 SEK 1R risk-parity position sizing so wide-stop bars reduce unit count automatically.
Never buy MSFT pinned underneath OR_High resistance; wait for confirmed 15m close above OR_High and anchor stop below intraday VWAP.
Because AAPL often has a tight 15m ATR (~$0.88), Avanza's 0.50% USD FX drag destroys tight scalps; only trade multi-ATR swings using Mini Futures (0.38% spread) when Net R:R >= 1.8.
